A proposal trace emitted pending outside the stable effect enum.
Terminal service and controller commands were absent before implementation; six initial terminal tests failed as expected.
Persisted undo initially read the wrong object key; its focused test failed before the correction.
Untrusted change listing and later bare status initially crossed the service trust gate; direct service tests observed each refusal gap red.
A confirmed apply conflict left stale in-memory pending state; the regression observed the stuck proposal before correction.
Full-screen rendering stripped diff line whitespace and the command palette omitted file controls; focused UI regressions observed both failures.
File commands initially failed to reacquire or validate the SessionFile writer snapshot; active-writer, external-append and persistence-loss tests observed the gaps.
Same-session undo initially reused the pre-apply write grant; the regression required a fresh post-apply grant.
Terminal review initially preserved Unicode bidi format controls; the focused diff test observed raw U+202E/U+2066 before escaping.
Legacy TUI command-order tests caught the first palette ordering regression before the original command order was restored.
Public README and CLI documentation initially denied or imprecisely described the trusted file-control surface; bounded review rounds kept those findings open until corrected.

findings.reason: Observed red same-run-id reuse and owner mismatch; a per-Session host token now prevents reuse and owner uses persisted conversation/branch.

An independently recorded namespace seam exposed pathname-only checks. A corrected canonical-path regression rejects the old seam; reads now attest and pin the opened workspace descriptor before no-follow traversal.
Red regression showed refused write_file inherited applied effect from the legacy result projector; the file-work refusal now explicitly records none.
Red enum check rejected pending in the stable trace schema; proposal trace stores proposed/change identity separately without extending the enum or claiming applied/read-only.

Three red Session subcases showed record/object persistence or raw I/O failures continued to a completed model run. The dispatcher now raises SessionError for direct or preserved underlying storage/I/O exceptions before bounded guard refusals; focused regression proves one provider request, failed terminal status, no pending proposal and unchanged target.
Each file command now reacquires the session writer and verifies the original SessionFile identity and size; missing persistence refuses before file control.
A verified apply consumes only the target write grant and advances policy generation, so undo requires a newly disclosed exact write grant.
Terminal rendering escapes C0/C1 and every Unicode Cf format control while preserving the complete underlying proposal binding.
Both file-work documents now distinguish trusted metadata listing from the fresh exact write grant required for undo.
The line banner names trusted file controls and the full-screen palette appends them without changing the legacy default command order.

English and Chinese READMEs plus CLI manuals now describe status versus disclosure, TTY/pipe boundaries, model limits, fresh undo grants and remaining package gaps without denying other configured capabilities.
The service trusted gate now precedes bare status and change listing; direct tests prove neither untrusted command reveals paths or creates the store.
